id.description: Identifier of the task: the prefix of the project and the number, such as SHOP-1. The event envelope names the task by it.

attempt.description: Attempt of the task, from 1: a cancelled task taken anew is the next attempt with the same identifier.

title.description: Title of the task: one line of up to 80 characters.

state.description: State of the task: active — in work, waiting — waits for the operator, closed — done, cancelled — given up.

scenario.description: Scenario of the task in the flow of the task.

stage.description: Current stage of the task; absent once the scenario is passed. A cancelled task stays at the stage it was cancelled at. Its exit, instruction and transitions are given by `gentry stage show`.

finished.description: The scenario of the task is passed: the task stays in work until it is closed, and has no stage.

progress.description: Progress of the task through its scenario.

worktree.description: Absolute path of the worktree the task holds; absent once the task released it: a closed or a cancelled task holds none.

flow.description: The commit that applied the flow of the task: the task follows that flow to its end, whatever is applied later.

statement.title: TaskStatement
statement.description: Statement of the task as passed, with its source.

source.description: Who passed the title and the statement: operator — the operator, agent — the agent wrote them from the words of the operator.

taken.description: Time the task was taken in UTC, RFC 3339 with milliseconds.

ended.description: When and by whom the task was closed or cancelled; present only for a closed or a cancelled task.

scenario.title: TaskScenario
scenario.description: Scenario of the task in the flow of the task.

stage.title: TaskStage
stage.description: Current stage of the task. Its exit, instruction and transitions are given by `gentry stage show`.

node.description: Node of the scenario the task is at.

id.description: Identifier of the stage of the node.

round.description: Number of the pass of the node in the task, from 1: a return to the node starts the next round.

progress.title: TaskProgress
progress.description: Progress of a task: stages passed of all stages of its way to the end. Ahead of a fork the total is a range, from the shortest way to the longest.

passed.description: Number of the nodes of the scenario closed by an exit or a skip; a return does not lower it.

total_min.description: passed plus the nodes not passed yet on the shortest way to the end, without returns.

total_max.description: passed plus the nodes not passed yet on the longest way to the end, without returns; equals total_min unless a fork is ahead.

ended.title: TaskEnded
ended.description: The closing or the cancelling of a task.

time.description: Time the task was closed or cancelled in UTC, RFC 3339 with milliseconds.

source.description: Who closed or cancelled the task: operator or agent.

reason.description: Why the task was cancelled; absent if no reason was given and for a closed task.
